# Toon Cat FREE

- **Model:** "Toon Cat FREE" by **Omabuarts Studio** (omabuarts)
- **Source:** https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/toon-cat-free-b2bd1ee7858444bda366110a2d960386

  https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/
- **File:** `toon_cat_free.glb`, the unmodified glTF binary from Sketchfab's download API (2026-10-12).

**Changes made for Purrifier:** the model is imported into Blender by
`Tools/blender/render_cat.py`, scaled, posed (curled up / lying), and animated with code
(breathing, blinks, ear twitches, tail motion, stretch), then rendered into the slot C
animations in `Assets/Animations/C/`. The mesh and texture themselves are not edited.

This credit must stay with the model and be repeated in the app's README / About screen.
